tools.name: request_review
tools.description: Ask MergeSafe to review the current head of a pull request; MergeSafe posts the review on the pull request. A head that was already reviewed is refused, not charged twice. Call it after pushing fixes.

tools.name: get_settings
tools.description: Read how this organization's MergeSafe is set up: for each setting its effective value, where the value comes from (repo_override, org, mixed with field_sources, mergesafe_default, or unchecked when it could not be read) and the values it may take, plus the settings version. tools.name: list_repositories
tools.description: List the repositories MergeSafe reviews for an organization, each with its effective level, plus the org's trigger mode and the GitHub link where the repository selection is changed (GitHub decides which repos are reviewed). Read-only. A Member sees only the repos their GitHub account can see.

tools.name: local_context_status
tools.description: Whether the repository's organization accepts local context (request_review_with_context). Ask before reading anything to send: when it is off, send nothing and use request_review.

tools.name: request_review_with_context
tools.description: Like request_review, but also sends excerpts of the tests of the files the pull request changes, read from your local checkout, so the review sees them. Only when local_context_status says enabled. Push first: head_sha is the commit you read at, and if the pull request's head is another commit nothi

tools.name: start_session
tools.description: Start a MergeSafe review session for local changes, before or without a pull request; nothing is posted to GitHub. FIRST ask the user for a cost limit for the session in US dollars and pass it as limit_usd: reviews stop when it is reached until the user approves more. Returns the session_id and how

tools.name: review_local
tools.description: Send the local diff for review and get its quote. Nothing runs yet: the answer says 'This review will cost you up to $X (Strong)' with the other levels' prices. Always show the user the price and ask them to confirm before you call confirm_review; never confirm on your own. Send each changed file wi

tools.name: review_branch
tools.description: Review a branch already pushed to GitHub, with no upload: MergeSafe reads the branch's changes from GitHub itself. Returns review_id with status 'fetching' (queued). Poll get_session_findings until this review is 'quoted', then show the user its price as for review_local and ask them to confirm befo

tools.name: confirm_review
tools.description: Run a quoted review at the level the user chose, ONLY after the user confirmed its price. The price is held; what is charged afterwards is never more. If the session's limit would be passed, nothing runs: ask the user, and use approve_more only if they agree. Then poll get_session_findings.

tools.name: approve_more
tools.description: Raise the session's cost limit by amount_usd. Only after the user explicitly agreed to that amount; never on your own.

tools.name: get_session_findings
tools.description: The session's findings (severity P0 most severe .. P3, file, lines, problem, suggestion, status: open, withdrawn or kept_at_p3, and any answer's verdict; a finding whose answer could not be judged is open again and may be answered) and the state of its latest review: running, done with the price cha

tools.name: answer_finding
tools.description: Answer a finding once per review (free): 'won't fix here' or why it is intended. MergeSafe judges the reply and withdraws the finding, keeps it at P3, or notes it; get_session_findings shows the verdict. For a fix, just review_local again: the next review re-checks the file.

tools.name: session_cost
tools.description: The session's total so far, its limit and what is left.

tools.name: prepare_upload
tools.description: Get a short-lived upload token for this open session (10 minutes, one upload). The local process POSTs the review's files to upload_path with it, so the file contents never pass through you. Then call review_local with the upload_id it returns. Spends nothing.

tools.name: end_session
tools.description: Close the session; the uploaded code is deleted. Findings are kept.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.mergesafe.ai" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_findings, list_repositories, request_review_with_context, review_local, review_branch, get_session_findings, prepare_upload · Private data: get_findings, request_review_with_context, review_local, get_session_findings, answer_finding, prepare_upload · Public sink: local_context_status, request_review_with_context, review_local, review_branch, prepare_upload · Destructive: get_findings, confirm_review.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_findings, list_repositories, request_review_with_context, review_local, review_branch, get_session_findings, prepare_upload · Private data: get_findings, request_review_with_context, review_local, get_session_findings, answer_finding, prepare_upload · Public sink: local_context_status, request_review_with_context, review_local, review_branch, prepare_upload · Destructive: get_findings, confirm_review

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
